description: How a TmMemoryPanel keeps the removals a reader may still take back. Single (the default) is the pre-2.11.0 rule: ONE undo window exists at a time, so a second Forget reports the first removal immediately. Queue keeps one window PER pending removal — each with its own countdown on the injected TimeProvider and its own undo row — so a reader who removes three memories in a row can still take back any of them. The stack is bounded by TmMemoryPanel.MaxVisibleUndoRows: past that bound the OLDEST pending removal is reported immediately rather than dropped off the screen, because a removal nobody can see and nobody was told about would be lost.
